requested.title: Password confirmation is not enforced by the server-side schema
deleteTodo reports success when no row was deleted

parsedVerdicts.reasoning: The original server-side validation gap was real, but `src/schemas/user-schemas.ts` now applies an object-level refinement requiring `password === passwordConfirmation`. `src/server/handlers/user-handlers.ts` registers this schema through `.validator(updateUserSchema)`, so mismatched values are rejected before `auth.api.changePassword` executes. If a non-empty password is supplied without confirmation, the confirmation defaults to an empty string and the equality check still fails. The handler can safely omit `passwordConfirmation` from the Better Auth call because equality has already been established server-side. The same cross-field refinement is now present on `signUpSchema`. Tests in `src/schemas/user-schemas.test.ts` explicitly cover rejection of mismatched profile and signup passwords. Git history and the stored revalidation identify commit `a041f94337e958247fb48f6d2ab0ed41cb6dc446` (`Harden session and profile data handling`) as introducing the patch, which remains in the current code.

The reported logic bug was valid in the original implementation because an empty array returned by Drizzle is truthy. The current `src/server/services/todo-service.ts` destructures the returned array with `const [todo] = await ...returning()`. When the compound todo-ID and user-ID predicate matches no row, `todo` is therefore undefined and `if (!todo)` throws `AppError("NOT_FOUND")` instead of returning success. The handler validates the identifier as a UUID and obtains the authenticated user through `useLoggedInAppSession`. The ownership predicate remains intact, preventing deletion of another user's row while now also producing the correct failure response. `src/server/services/todo-service.server.test.ts` covers nonexistent and cross-user todo IDs, expects `NOT_FOUND`, and confirms that the cross-user row remains present. Git history and the stored revalidation identify commit `a041f94337e958247fb48f6d2ab0ed41cb6dc446` (`Harden session and profile data handling`) as introducing this correction.
